datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field assessments to classify acute food insecurity using the IPC methodology. Geographic data representing IPC classification phases were collected for multiple scenarios and time periods (February, June, October 2017) and compiled into spatial datasets (GeoJSON/KML format) representing food insecurity impact classifications at the sub-national level.
